fact: In a 2022 survey of 48 health facilities in Montserrado, Margibi and Grand Bassa, all 48 reported filling paper HMIS forms and submitting them to the District or County Health Team's office, as is required in Liberia, where district or county data clerks enter the values into the DHIS2 database (compared as downloaded on 16 November 2022).
title: Comprehensive Facility Survey Report for the Maternal Syphilis Program in Liberia
